pr_title: Only add default services once in WebApplicationBuilder
pr_comments: I debugged the issue, the IWebHostEnvironment.ApplicationName is incorrect and it results in not being able to find controllers or views.
This PR gave me clarity on how we should fix the remaining issues with the WebApplicationBuilder.

issue_context.title: WebApplicationBuilder adds default services twice
issue_context.body:
After my [change](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/33800) got merged Swashbuckle broke when using the `WebApplicationBuilder` and it's because we call  ConfigureWebHostDefaults twice: 
1. https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/348b810d286fd2258aa763d6eda667a83ff972dc/src/DefaultBuilder/src/WebApplicationBuilder.cs#L52
2. https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/348b810d286fd2258aa763d6eda667a83ff972dc/src/DefaultBuilder/src/WebApplicationBuilder.cs#L111

Assuming it was fine to do so but it isn't when using API explorer because we end up adding the same provider twice which makes swashbuckle (and I assume other code) unhappy. Swagger/OpenAPI is currently broken because of this.

cc @halter73 @LadyNaggaga @bradygaster
comments:
Yeah. I knew this might be bad. That's why I left this comment saying "We call ConfigureWebHostDefaults AGAIN...". 😆 

https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/348b810d286fd2258aa763d6eda667a83ff972dc/src/DefaultBuilder/src/WebApplicationBuilder.cs#L108-L111

review_comments: Why do we `ApplyConfigurationSettings` twice when nothing is observing changes to `_environment` between these 2 calls.?

This isn't new. ConfigureHostConfiguration callbacks to read environment variables (e.g. `DOTNET_` and `ASPNETCORE_`) that need to be reacted to before running ConfigureAppConfiguration callbacks to read config that's dependent on the environment name configured by the environment variables (e.g. `appsettings.{env.EnvironmentName}.json` and user secrets).

This is the last call to `ApplyConfigurationSettings` before the WebApplicationBuilder ctor exits, so it's to ensure app code in Program.cs can observe any changes made to the environment in appsettings mostly.

After playing with this a bit I think we only need to read hosting configuration once at the beginning and blocking it after that. We should also get rid of our custom IWebHostEnvironment and should use the one configured in the `IHostBuilder.Properties[typeof(WebHostContext)]`
Not part of this PR but we should talk about ways to throw if `UseEnvironment` is used after this call (and maybe we need a first class API).
Do you even need to do this?

If not, we get test failures [here](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/dd476b1fdfd851dcfe0cab21c5084f05059de6bb/src/DefaultBuilder/test/Microsoft.AspNetCore.Tests/WebApplicationTests.cs#L189) and other similar places since WebApplication.Environment pulls from the IServiceProvider and we no longer register our IWebHostEnvironment as a service.
